component: P16 evidence, task, bundle, direct federation and bounded inbox review
constraints: Evidence: one to sixteen immutable blobs, each at most 65536 bytes; exact signed set and ordered metadata preservation; no content interpretation.
Tasks and bundles: closed canonical 65536-byte descriptions, external pins, immutable envelope/policy bytes, exact resource budget and current trust revalidation; no execution authority.
Federation: at most sixteen direct peers with exact issuer/capability restrictions and independent revision/time floors; no transitive identity or rule language.
Inbox: synchronous in-process calls, at most sixteen items and 1 MiB logical retained payload, per-peer quotas, expiry and clock-fault closure within one critical section.
Offline general-purpose OS library boundaries; no specified target hardware, WCET, RSS, contention throughput or availability guarantee.
alternatives: Python immutable bytes/tuples, lexical JSON hooks, native SHA-256 and deque plus explicit lock.
Rust immutable borrowing, serde_json/sha2 and crossbeam bounded channels with additional quota/expiry accounting.
C#/F# Utf8JsonReader, SHA256.HashData and bounded channels with caller-owned stable input buffers.
Erlang/Elixir OTP JSON callbacks, immutable binaries, crypto hashing and isolated processes with explicit mailbox admission bounds.
Cedar policies or OPA/Rego for rule-based federation; these do not themselves authenticate artifact bytes or implement the closed direct-table contract.
rationale: Evidence KEEP: exact immutable inputs and native per-blob hashing implement the no-mutation/no-aggregate-copy requirement; the reviewed native and managed alternatives offer no established advantage under this bounded contract.
Task KEEP: lexical callbacks preserve duplicate and numeric-token rejection; direct canonical byte equality checks the versioned contract without adding a second parser or an IPC encoding boundary.

Bundle KEEP: direct public-verifier composition retains exact snapshots and avoids a separate trust-policy acceptance implementation. New tests cover signed kind/digest/outcome order; production behavior is unchanged.

Federation KEEP: a bounded direct-match table expresses every required decision without introducing a rule interpreter or workload enrollment dependency. New tests catch evidence kind relabeling at the return boundary.

Inbox KEEP: one lock atomically combines byte/count/per-peer quota and expiry/clock-fault transitions. Channels need equivalent application accounting; a mailbox alone is not a byte-bound admission gate.
The decision depends on current data ownership and acceptance semantics, not installed tooling, familiarity or rewrite cost. No comparative runtime benchmark or native migration winner is asserted.
limits: Alternative technologies were researched but not implemented or benchmarked in this slice. New native deployment or measured resource requirements reopen selection.
116 focused methods pass; two new full-reference tests reject two independent in-memory relabeling variants that passed the older component suites.
Publication repair normalizes executable paths in two historical records with explicit redaction provenance. It does not alter the peer-owned release checker or erase prior failed evidence.
No full repository check, installed-package run, target hardware measurement, physical integration, MLS/CNSA certification or uptime claim. Insufficient information for tactical deployment.
Remaining schema, packaging and consumer/probe review plus unfinished P16-P19 software prevents audit or phase completion.
